title: Faunology
description: A cozy little mod that adds little creatures!
body:
# Summary:
Faunology is a simple Minecraft mod that adds new animals to the game, starting with an owl. The mod aims to expand the wildlife in your Minecraft world, with plans for more animals in future updates.

# Features:
New Animal - Owl: Encounter an owl in the night in every biome!

Lightweight and Simple: The mod is easy to install and requires no additional textures or sounds, keeping it lightweight and accessible.

# Compatibility:
Minecraft Version: 1.20.6 - NeoForge

Dependencies: GeckoLib

# Future Plans:
* capybaras and whales are coming soon!
* various food items relating to the animals.
* tools and armor relating to the animals.

Developer: GotThatGrass
